supportedClaims: Threshold crossing is NOT High-basin entry
K-graft is anti-aligned with true High-entry vector
Natural High states are lower-d, higher-K, narrower-K_std
Before-Cupd d-compression is the correct geometric entry direction
Compression room is strongest persistence predictor
Pathway matching matters - mismatched protocol = 0% strict
N=71 and N=72 show pathway activity
conditionalClaims: Crypto-Hi mild pathway candidate sufficient (9% rate)
Pathway selection has control value (10% vs 6% universal)
